# ContamCal Experiment Plan
# Each experiment maps to Core Claims in paper_framing.md
# Priority: P0 = must-run, P1 = important, P2 = bonus

experiments:
  # ============================================================
  # P0: Core experiments — must complete for submission
  # ============================================================

  - id: exp-001
    name: controlled_sft_injection
    claim: [1]
    description: >
      SFT contamination injection on Qwen2.5-0.5B/1.5B/3B at 5 dosage levels
      (0%, 5%, 25%, 50%, 100% benchmark items as paraphrases in SFT data).
      Produces ground-truth contaminated/clean model pairs. 15 SFT runs total
      (3 models × 5 dosages), parallelized across GPUs. 3 seeds per condition
      for key metrics (mean ± std).
      Paraphrase generation: use strong open LLM (Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct or
      equivalent) with controlled semantic similarity — following methodology
      of "Rethinking Benchmark and Contamination" (arXiv 2023). Target:
      high semantic similarity (cosine >0.85) but low lexical overlap
      (BLEU <0.3) to evade n-gram decontamination while preserving
      contamination effect. Quality validation: automated similarity metrics
      + human spot-check on 50 random pairs per benchmark.
    priority: P0
    gpu_budget_hours: 50
    deps: []
    benchmarks: [MMLU, GSM8K, ARC-Challenge, HumanEval]
    models: [Qwen2.5-0.5B, Qwen2.5-1.5B, Qwen2.5-3B]
    seeds: 3
    registry_id:
      - exp_001_sft_injection        # paraphrase generation + data prep
      - exp_001_sft_0pct_05B         # 0.5B s42 baseline (DONE/success)
      - exp_001_sft_0pct_15B         # 1.5B s42 baseline (DONE/success)
      - exp_001_sft_0pct_3B          # 3B s42 baseline (RUNNING)
      - exp_001_sft_0pct_05B_s123    # 0.5B s123 baseline (RUNNING)
      - exp_001_sft_0pct_15B_s123    # 1.5B s123 baseline (RUNNING)
      - exp_001_sft_0pct_3B_s123     # 3B s123 baseline (RUNNING)
      - exp_001_eval_15B_d000_s42    # 1.5B eval (RUNNING)

  - id: exp-002
    name: stage1_signal_pipeline
    claim: [2]
    description: >
      Compute 4 detection signals on all contaminated + clean models from exp-001:
      (a) embedding-based semantic retrieval (FAISS + sentence-transformers),
      (b) Min-K%++ membership inference,
      (c) ConStat performance gap (original vs paraphrased items),
      (d) Self-Critique entropy collapse.
      Output: per-model-item exposure scores for each signal.
    priority: P0
    gpu_budget_hours: 20
    deps: [exp-001]

  - id: exp-003
    name: rrf_aggregation_ablation
    claim: [2]
    description: >
      RRF fusion of 4 signals into composite per-item exposure score.
      Ablations: (a) RRF vs equal-weight rank averaging, (b) single-signal only
      (×4), (c) calibration-based weighted RRF variant, (d) false positive
      injection robustness check (inject FP at rates matching Duan et al. 2024).
      Also test degraded 2-signal mode (ConStat + Self-Critique) for closed-weight.
    priority: P0
    gpu_budget_hours: 2
    deps: [exp-002]

  - id: exp-004
    name: simulation_identifiability_sweep
    claim: [1, 3]
    description: >
      Systematic synthetic-data sweep (NEW, not MVP — MVP only covered 4-5 conditions):
      exposure signal AUC (0.55, 0.60, 0.65, 0.70, 0.80, 0.90) ×
      model count (20, 50, 100, 200) ×
      prior strength (N(0,0.5), N(0,1), N(0,2)) ×
      exposure type (binary, continuous).
      144 conditions, 10 seeds each. Reports: θ-γ recovery RMSE, posterior
      correlation, coverage (50%/80%/95%), prior sensitivity. Establishes
      minimum AUC threshold; if 95% CI width > 15pp at AUC=0.65, label as
      "cannot distinguish no contamination from moderate contamination."
      N_items=300 fixed (per MVP finding).
      Subsumes exp-010 (prior sensitivity) and exp-011 (few-examinee regime)
      — prior × N_models dimensions already in sweep grid. Growing Pains
      pre-estimation sub-experiment: at N_models=20/50, compare flat prior
      vs informative prior from pre-estimated item parameters.
      Also includes Fisher Information matrix analysis: derive approximate
      analytical relationship between signal AUC, N_models, and γ
      recoverability. Distinguish structural identifiability (parameters
      uniquely determined) from practical identifiability (estimation
      quality sufficient for decisions). Provides theoretical grounding
      for the empirical AUC ≥ 0.70 threshold.
    priority: P0
    gpu_budget_hours: 0
    deps: []
    note: CPU only. MVP (mvp_sim_4pl_gamma) was preliminary; this is the full sweep.
    registry_id:
      - exp_004_sim_sweep            # full sweep (RUNNING)
      - mvp_sim_4pl_gamma            # MVP predecessor (DONE/success)
      - mvp_sim_confounding          # MVP confounding test (DONE/success)

  - id: exp-005
    name: noise_propagation_analysis
    claim: [3]
    description: >
      Two parts:
      (A) Measurement error model (PRIMARY): extend Stan model to treat exposure
      as noisy observation: exposure_ij ~ N(τ_ij, σ_e²), where τ is latent true
      contamination. σ_e estimated from exp-001 ground truth FP/FN rates.
      This propagates Stage 1 uncertainty into posteriors automatically.
      Compare coverage (50%/80%/95%) vs point-estimate exposure baseline.
      (B) Post-hoc noise injection: inject Gaussian noise at 1×/1.5×/2× matched
      levels, re-fit standard model, measure CI widening for γ and θ.
      Both parts inform whether measurement error model closes the coverage gap.
    priority: P0
    gpu_budget_hours: 0
    deps: [exp-002, exp-004]
    note: CPU only
    registry_id:
      - exp_005_noise_prop_v2        # v2 with Stan fixes (RUNNING)
      - exp_005_noise_prop            # v1 failed (DONE/failed, sigma_e=0 bug)

  - id: exp-006
    name: irt_calibration_and_baselines
    claim: [1, 3]
    description: >
      Fit 4PL+γ IRT (Stan NUTS) on controlled models from exp-001/003.
      PRIMARY: per-benchmark fitting with benchmark-specific γ_k — this is
      the natural parameterization when IRT is fitted per-benchmark (each
      benchmark's model has its own γ_k). ABLATION: joint fitting across
      benchmarks with shared global γ (stronger assumption, tests whether
      contamination effect is homogeneous across benchmarks). Report both.
      Per-benchmark fitting (not joint) is the default to reduce local
      independence violation scope. Posterior predictive checks on item-level residual
      correlations to assess local independence empirically.
      Compute calibrated scores via exposure=0 counterfactual with CIs.
      Compare against 7 baselines:
      (0) Raw — no adjustment (anchor),
      (1) remove-and-rescore (drop flagged items),
      (2) single-signal 2PL+γ (best signal only, simpler IRT),
      (3) vanilla 4PL without γ (standard IRT, no contamination modeling),
      (4) linear exposure regression + bootstrap CI (simplest post-hoc),
      (5) Emperor's mitigation: rephrasing + option shuffling,
      (6) DCR fuzzy inference (EMNLP 2025) — the only existing method
          producing adjusted accuracy; must include or reviewers will reject.
      Evaluate all 5 metrics: MAE, coverage (50%/80%/95%), sharpness,
      Kendall τ, dose-response monotonicity.
      Report mean ± std across 3 seeds (matched to exp-001 seeds).
    priority: P0
    gpu_budget_hours: 8
    deps: [exp-003]
    benchmarks: [MMLU, GSM8K, ARC-Challenge, HumanEval]
    seeds: 3

  # ============================================================
  # P1: Important — run if time/GPU permit
  # ============================================================

  - id: exp-015
    name: sft_d100_qc_only
    claim: [1]
    description: >
      100% dosage SFT using only QC-pass paraphrases (7547/16697 items).
      Isolates noisy vs clean contamination confound identified by reviewer.
      D012 decision. Compare calibration metrics against exp-001 d100 (all
      paraphrases) to quantify effect of noisy contamination on IRT estimates.
    priority: P1
    gpu_budget_hours: 5
    deps: [exp-001]
    benchmarks: [MMLU, GSM8K, ARC-Challenge, HumanEval]
    models: [Qwen2.5-0.5B]
    seeds: 1
    status: planned
    registry_id:
      - exp_001_sft_d100_qc_only
    data_script: exp001/prepare_qc_only_data.py

  - id: exp-007
    name: scale_bridging_7b
    claim: [1]
    description: >
      Qwen2.5-7B controlled SFT injection at 5 dosage levels.
      Validates calibration accuracy scales to larger models.
      Requires multi-GPU node (7B LoRA SFT ~4-8h per run on 1×H100).
    priority: P1
    gpu_budget_hours: 30
    deps: [exp-001]

  - id: exp-008
    name: signal_survival_analysis
    claim: [2]
    description: >
      Systematic evaluation of detection signal reliability across training regimes.
      Signal × regime AUC heatmap: 4 signals × {base, SFT-clean, SFT-contaminated,
      RL-post-trained}. Confirms Self-Critique compensates where Min-K%++/ConStat
      degrade post-RL (per fragility paper arXiv 2510.02386).
      ELEVATED to Core Contribution 2 per Dream review (all 3 tiers identified
      this as the most genuinely novel finding).
    priority: P0
    gpu_budget_hours: 10
    deps: [exp-002]

  - id: exp-014
    name: multi_family_validation
    claim: [1]
    description: >
      Controlled SFT injection on at least one non-Qwen model family
      (Llama-3.2-1B or Pythia-1.4B) at 3 dosage levels (0%, 25%, 100%).
      Validates that identifiability boundaries and calibration accuracy
      generalize beyond Qwen2.5. Addresses Dream reviewer concern about
      single model family limiting generalizability (flagged [M][W]).
    priority: P1
    gpu_budget_hours: 15
    deps: [exp-001]

  - id: exp-009
    name: rl_observational_case_study
    claim: [2, 3]
    description: >
      Apply Self-Critique + available signals to existing RL-trained models:
      Qwen2.5-Instruct (0.5B/1.5B/3B/7B), DeepSeek-R1-Distill-1.5B/7B.
      Fit IRT with appropriately wider CIs. Expected regret quantification:
      compare uncalibrated vs calibrated vs remove-rescore for top-5 model
      selection. Framed as observational — directional external validity,
      not full quantitative validation. Near-zero γ check on known-clean
      benchmark (specificity test).
    priority: P1
    gpu_budget_hours: 15
    deps: [exp-006, exp-008]

  # exp-010 (prior_sensitivity) and exp-011 (few_examinee_regime) merged into exp-004.
  # Prior × N_models dimensions already covered in the sweep grid.

  # ============================================================
  # P2: Bonus — adds breadth if resources allow
  # ============================================================

  - id: exp-012
    name: observational_72b
    claim: [1]
    description: >
      Qwen2.5-72B observational analysis (inference only, no SFT).
      Extends ecological validity to frontier model scale.
    priority: P2
    gpu_budget_hours: 15
    deps: [exp-006]

  - id: exp-013
    name: closed_weight_2signal_mode
    claim: [2]
    description: >
      Degraded 2-signal mode (ConStat + Self-Critique, no logits/embeddings)
      for closed-weight models. Ablation quantifying 2-signal vs 4-signal
      calibration accuracy gap.
    priority: P2
    gpu_budget_hours: 5
    deps: [exp-003]

# ============================================================
# GPU Budget Summary
# ============================================================
gpu_budget:
  P0_hours: 90
  P1_hours: 60
  P2_hours: 20
  buffer_hours: 30
  total_hours: 200
  note: >
    CPU-only experiments (exp-004, exp-005, exp-011) excluded.
    Buffer covers reruns, debugging, multi-seed overhead, and unexpected issues.
    Requires 2-4× H100/A100-80G for parallel SFT runs.

    - With 4× H100: P0 in ~4 days, P1 in ~3 days, total ~8 days (fits deadline)
    - With 2× H100: P0 in ~7 days, P1 in ~4 days, tight but feasible if parallelized
